title: Georgia's 6th Congressional District election, 2026
description: The 2026 general election for Georgia's 6th Congressional District pits Democratic incumbent Lucy McBath against Republican nominee Kevin Martin. The district covers parts of Cobb, Douglas, Fulton, and Fayette counties in Atlanta's western suburbs and has become reliably Democratic in recent cycles. McBath, first elected in 2018, is seeking a fourth term after briefly exploring a run for governor before suspending that bid to focus on her husband's health. The race is rated 'Solid D' by the Cook Political Report and is not considered highly competitive. McBath won the seat in 2024 with nearly 75% of the vote.

candidates.name: Lucy McBath
candidates.summary: Lucy McBath is a Democratic U.S. Representative from Georgia first elected in 2018. She became a gun control advocate after her son Jordan Davis was murdered in 2012, and worked with Everytown for Gun Safety and Moms Demand Action before running for Congress. McBath previously worked as a flight attendant for Delta Air Lines for 30 years and holds a B.A. in political science from Virginia State University.

candidates.name: Kevin Martin
candidates.summary: Kevin Martin is the Republican nominee for Georgia's 6th Congressional District. He is a controller from Smyrna, Georgia, and a lifetime resident of the district. Martin won the Republican primary on May 19, 2026, defeating Justin Pinker, and is running on a platform of conservative Christian values, with a focus on common-sense governance, crime, and tax issues.
